title: Registering a channel that says it steers its room turns but does not serialize them fails and registers nothing; one that steers and serializes them registers
notes: Python: core/mixins/channel_ops.py _refuse_unserialized_steering; roomkit-rs: roomkit kit/registry.rs. RK-6.4-456 is cited in part: that serializes_room_turns defaults to steers_room_turns, a channel's own declaration, and that an owner holding a channel by a declaration that steers takes its turns as serialized, are not observed: each implementation's tests pin them (tests/test_room_turns_in_order.py::test_a_channel_that_steers_its_room_turns_says_it_serializes_them; roomkit-rs crates/roomkit/tests/turns/steering.rs::a_channel_that_steers_its_room_turns_says_it_serializes_them).
